book.name: Salmos
book.title: Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu

content: Urutamari Apanll taaratartanlliya. Itaru, chiy tputsich nutsich musásimashi anoo kamankiya

content.text: Apaa, shiycha iyaa kapung tapachindampanish.
Iyashchi tputs uru shiyash kamunganiya.
Ndatumastaa macheewa, mishat tsapurunaseetstam tinchush, shiy urutari taarangsha.
Mishat, tsapurunasee uru tinayarush shiy wand urutari Apanllish kurakish taarangsha.
Shiy urutamari Apanllish taaratartanllsha.
Apaa, shiy tputseetsich, Waani tsipachpa;
tsapoomtam puyumboom kinachpa, tákchush, tputssha tsipakanaya.
Shiyaamanaa Apaa, minam mil masach minampaz zar ashiru tushiykiya.
Shiyaam minampaz maats ashiru nda táchaksha.
Apaa, shiy shaana zandkush wizpurpatish tputseetsich machiksha.
Iy taarasheetsini pamazukpazich ashiru mikeeru kanatsipkiniya.
Iy tputsini chirichirpaz ashiruni musásiri tsipakaniya.
Napa chirichir wanasir kxuneeru, puturit wanasiri chaptayaru,
itaru zar pukamachsha mawiruyaru, tsipatariya.
Chy tputsich ashkitamchi.
Shiy tsiyantakachush, musásiri iyaa tpachingamaam waritaksha.
Ashkachush, iysha mangini tsípataraa ashchiniya.
Shiy iyaa yutaritshishiri ichingaru yasaksha.
¿Yapeeja chiy kamungchich?
Shiy tsiyantakchush, uru taarashini tsípchiya.
Tputsich masachirich kambusurpaz ashiru tushiyshtar ashkiya.
70 masach tputs taakiya. Itaru, tputs kizpur putit 80 masach taamaam waritakiya.
Kapungtaa taakuch, itaru xarashish uru iyaam tachitarpaz ashkiya.
Mikeeru tushiyshtar ashku, chiy mikeeru tsipachich.
¿Chakaja shiyaa tsiyanish yasach?
¿Tamayari shiyaa tsiyanish kamungchich?
Ashirucha Apaa, putam putam ashiru mangeetsini p'tseengcha nda mangutaritini taamaama.
Mangiptartanaariniya taakuni, shiyaa aranginasha mangoonachshapariniya.
Apaa, iyaatssha yusur wanasir chinangcha.
¿Ashinooja iyaa istachish? Iyaa nayaningcha.
Watam iyaa shaana tputsirshawa.
Uru zar taraseekchu anush, chinasheetsish iyaam panangcha.
Mangishini tatsitangcha.
Ashkachush, iysha uru shiyaa mangini kis yasichinipa.
Apaa, ¿wanip masach na kiyung kachiykuni taakaniya?
Itaru, Apaa, shiy ashpirittam masachee tatsamooru kis taamaam iyaam wayangcha.
Ashkachush, iysha mishat iy ipartamani shiyaa wanasirimshirish pangchinlliniya.
Shiy iyaa kizpur istakush, anoo kis pangchiniya.
Ashiriya Apaa, shiy kchinamsheerush, iyaa kapung istangcha.
Iyaa tarawazirini, shiysha Apaa, wanasiri napangcha.
Zurkuri tina, Apaa. Iyaa istangcha.

footnotes.text: Ipísshucheema 5.15-16; Kólosénshucheema 4.5 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
